snippet.title: Corgi Race Live Trailer (Available Now Steam)
snippet.description:
A closer look at the other half of the Corgi Race experience, Corgi Race Live. Stream races out live on Twitch and have your chat join in and compete as they pick winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard.

You can also play along in other streams with your own version of Corgi Race as you can link to a streamer's race board to get all the info you need on the competitors in the race to make the best pick possible.

All this and you can still play solo; run your own stable, raise and train your corgi from a promising puppy to a legendary champion with all the twists and turns the come along the track to success.

Wishlist today on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2823250/Corgi_Race/

Music:
"Lazer Beam" - Matrika
